Running command: python3 -c "
import struct

with open('/tmp/seed_0.jpg', 'rb') as f:
    data = f.read()

# Parse JPEG markers
i = 0
while i < len(data):
    if data[i] != 0xFF:
        i += 1
        continue
    marker = data[i+1]
    if marker == 0xD8:  # SOI
        print(f'SOI at {i}')
        i += 2
    elif marker == 0xD9:  # EOI
        print(f'EOI at {i}')
        break
    elif marker == 0xDA:  # SOS
        print(f'SOS at {i}')
        length = struct.unpack('>H', data[i+2:i+4])[0]
        print(f'  Length: {length}')
        # Parse component info
        ns = data[i+4]
        print(f'  Number of components: {ns}')
        pos = i+5
        for c in range(ns):
            comp_id = data[pos]
            table = data[pos+1]
            print(f'  Component {comp_id}: table={table>>4}, dc={table&0xF}')
            pos += 2
        break
    elif marker in [0xC0, 0xC1, 0xC2, 0xC3, 0xC4, 0xC5, 0xC6, 0xC7, 0xC9, 0xCA, 0xCB, 0xCD, 0xCE, 0xCF]:
        print(f'SOF marker {hex(marker)} at {i}')
        length = struct.unpack('>H', data[i+2:i+4])[0]
        precision = data[i+4]
        height = struct.unpack('>H', data[i+5:i+7])[0]
        width = struct.unpack('>H', data[i+7:i+9])[0]
        ncomp = data[i+9]
        print(f'  Precision: {precision}, Height: {height}, Width: {width}, Components: {ncomp}')
        pos = i+10
        for c in range(ncomp):
            comp_id = data[pos]
            sampling = data[pos+1]
            quant = data[pos+2]
            print(f'  Component {comp_id}: sampling={sampling>>4}x{sampling&0xF}, quant={quant}')
            pos += 3
        i += 2 + length
    elif marker == 0xDB:  # DQT
        print(f'DQT at {i}')
        i += 2 + struct.unpack('>H', data[i+2:i+4])[0]
    elif marker == 0xC4:  # DHT
        print(f'DHT at {i}')
        i += 2 + struct.unpack('>H', data[i+2:i+4])[0]
    elif marker == 0xDD:  # DRI
        print(f'DRI at {i}')
        i += 2 + struct.unpack('>H', data[i+2:i+4])[0]
    elif marker == 0xE0:  # APP0
        print(f'APP0 at {i}')
        i += 2 + struct.unpack('>H', data[i+2:i+4])[0]
    elif marker == 0xFE:  # COM
        print(f'COM at {i}')
        i += 2 + struct.unpack('>H', data[i+2:i+4])[0]
    else:
        print(f'Unknown marker {hex(marker)} at {i}')
        i += 2
"
